newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BCP to be traded in London.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BCP to be traded in London.

text.p: Banco Comercial Portugues, Portugal's largest private-sector bank, is to be quoted on the London stock exchange, the bank said in a statement.
Trade in BCP stock will start on Thursday, October 17.
The bank's full 136,686 shares will be quoted, it said.
BCP is also quoted in New York as an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) and in Frankfurt.
With its quotation in three different European markets, BCP qualifies to be part of Eurolist, a premier league of top European shares, the bank said.
